title.zh: 增加南苏里高省Tandag市镇南苏里高省医院的床位容量并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of Surigao Del Sur Provincial Hospital in the Municipality of Tandag, Province of Surigao Del Sur, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor.
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of Surigao Del Sur Provincial Hospital in the Municipality of Tandag, Province of Surigao Del Sur, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor.

text.en: The bed capacity of Surigao del Sur Provincial Hospital in the Municipality of Tandag, Province of Surigao del Sur, is hereby increased to seventy-five beds.
The necessary sums for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

In addition, the sum of five hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the construction of the buildings and the acquisition of fixtures and equipment.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 17, 1972.
